headline: Ravens' Jesse Minter optimistic QB Lamar Jackson can return vs. Bills
summary: Ravens coach Jesse Minter expressed optimism Monday that quarterback Lamar Jackson could be available for Sunday's game against the Bills.

headline: Source: Seahawks LT Charles Cross has high ankle sprain, likely to miss time
summary: Seahawks left tackle Charles Cross suffered a high ankle sprain and is expected to miss time, a source told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

headline: Cardinals WR Jalen Brooks will undergo season-ending wrist surgery
summary: Cardinals wide receiver Jalen Brooks announced on social media that he will undergo season-ending wrist surgery.

headline: Vikings RB Jones avoids serious knee injury, day-to-day
summary: Vikings running back Aaron Jones Sr. avoided a serious knee injury Sunday and is considered day-to-day, coach Kevin O'Connell confirmed Monday.
